_comment: SINGLE canonical qualifying-receipt predicate. All consumers (Rust validate_status.rs + history_queries.rs via assess, Python query.py + publish_receipt.py + anchor_select.py + finalize_receipt.py, bash/jq verify_receipt.sh) MUST read this file instead of an inline copy, so tightening the floor is ONE edit here. Colocated with rebase-base-floors.json / gate_floors.py. Drift resolutions per task one-shared-qualifying-receipt-predicate-five-consumers-bypass-the-registry (design note 2026-08-04 18:17); source sweep ai_docs/2026-08-04-floor-consumer-sweep.md.
_completeness_is_coverage_not_count: For a count-capable receipt (schema_version >= counts_schema), every declared outer gate must be accounted for and per-test-node COVERAGE must be satisfied (planned_test_nodes > 0 AND no zero_executed_nodes AND no absent_nodes). The executed_tests COUNT is not a completeness discriminator: it is a proxy in BOTH directions (landed dev-hermit d05874e; proof ee303899: 8 PASS rows at executed=427 but coverage 4/19 planned nodes, 15 absent -> legitimately NOT full green). executed_tests_min below is ONLY the surviving zero-execution floor (a run that executed nothing is never green); old-schema receipts that predate coverage fall back to it because it is the strongest thing they can prove.
_passed_tests_is_framework_owned: Schema-4 and newer passing rows must carry the test framework's passed_tests count and it must exactly equal executed_tests. Missing, null, malformed, or unequal values are contradictory or absent green evidence and refuse qualification. Pre-schema-4 history retains the former optional-field semantics.
_accepts_green_class: WHICH GREEN CLASS MAY LAND. hard = validation executed at THIS exact head. soft-* = inherited from an ancestor head and speculatively trusted (the row carries validated_head_sha != commit plus an inherited_from provenance block). Defaulting to [hard] keeps today's behaviour EXACTLY -- measured: all 585 pre-provenance live ledger rows classify hard, because a row with no validated_head_sha derives it as commit. Derivation and refusal rules are mirrored by ci-hub/validate/green_class.py and ci-hub/lib/qualifying_receipt.rs; the cross-consumer mutation test requires both engines to agree.
_cell_results_are_closed_typed_evidence: Schema-6 and schema-7 receipts require a stable top-level row.run_id, bind cell_results.run_id to it, bind the exact selected cell population, and bind a parent-root-relative retained results artifact strictly below ignored/validate/artifacts/. Schema 7 names the current complete comparison shape; schema 6 retains the two exact older rows without granting their absent fields authority. A schema above supported_schema_max remains readable but cannot qualify until the reader is updated. record_id is an event identity and may change when finalization creates a correction; run_id and cell_results remain unchanged. Checkout-local artifacts are refused because production removes the fresh validation checkout. Every selected cell carries exactly one of compared-and-matched, compared-and-diverged, performs-no-comparison-by-design, or unavailable-with-reason, plus exactly one per-cell tier: canonical-bitwise, exit-and-stream-equality, execution-only-self-consistent, or declared-but-unverifiable. Tiers classify the evidence for that exact cell and run, never a backend as a whole; declared-but-unverifiable records the current evidence state and does not claim a permanent backend limitation. Process exit never supplies a default. Historical schema-5 rows remain readable but make no per-cell comparison claim and retain their existing record_id-derived event run identity.
_base_evidence_is_load_bearing: Schema-5+ receipts carry the exact Hermit main base they contain, that base's tree, and the exact pinned Reverie SHA and tree. Mutable-tip currency and actual Hermit containment are asserted once by this same semantic authority at the final merge boundary. Schema-4 remains grandfathered-unknown; ancestry-within-a-budget is deliberately unsupported. Build-subtree reuse is deliberately absent: review measured only 1/48 landed pin transitions reusable, while sound guards would require tracing arbitrary build-script filesystem access.
_admission_provenance_is_load_bearing: Schema-5+ receipts must prove that the run was admitted by the canonical ci-hub validate lock, that its producer verified live owner ancestry, and that no more than five competing validates were observed. These are exact receipt conditions, not labels inferred from profile/selection. Schema-4 remains grandfathered-unknown and is not newly rejected. The semantic implementation lives only in ci-hub/qualifying_receipt.py::admission_verdict; Rust delegates this clause to that function and verify_receipt.sh reaches it through the Rust receipt-digest consumer.
_producer_names_the_writer_so_provenance: WHO WROTE THIS ROW. Establishing that for ONE row (the schema-4 correction carrying corrects/correction_author) took JSON-WHITESPACE FORENSICS -- separators, then a git log -S across three repos -- because no row says who produced it. `producer` is that missing column, and it lives HERE rather than in a second checker so there is ONE table (task every-ledger-writer-stamps-producer-and-the-reader-refuses-rows-without-it; it is the provenance half of declare-required-columns-per-schema-version-nonverdict-on-missing). NOT INTRODUCED BY A SCHEMA BUMP: 0 of 729 live rows carry producer and the top live schema is 5, so an unconditional requirement uncounts the entire history and blocks all landing; and bumping writers past 4 is independently unsafe because ci-hub.rs:3528 and :3589 branch on schema_version == 4 by EXACT EQUALITY. The applicability key is therefore `finished_at` (present on 729/729 rows), mirroring the coverage.applies_at_schema_min precedent one field over. HONEST LIMIT: `producer` is SELF-DECLARED. It binds a row to a CLAIMED writer, not a proven one, so it is not attestation and a determined forger can copy a registered slug; what it buys is that an unattributed row is refused ON SIGHT and the writer set becomes enumerable and auditable.
_producer_applies_from_finished_at_is_nu: INERT UNTIL EVERY WRITER SHIPS. The live writers span THREE repos -- parent (ci-hub/validate/finalize_receipt.py, direct to main), hermit (scripts/validate.rs), and reverie (validate.sh). Hermit's retired shell-producer slug remains known only so historical rows still parse. Enforcing from an epoch that precedes all writer landings would refuse valid rows made in the gap and block ALL landing, so the policy is versioned here BEFORE its consumers deploy. Flipping this null to an RFC3339 UTC instant AFTER the last writer is confirmed live is the one-line activation, and that same change should promote `producer` to a mandatory key in qualifying_receipt.py:load() and drop the serde default in lib/qualifying_receipt.rs. INERT IS NOT UNTESTED: the mutation suite sets this epoch in a FIXTURE predicate and proves the refusal actually fires, so both directions are bracketed with the gate live.

producer._known_is_repo_qualified_because_writer_: A bare historical `validate.sh` cannot say whether it came from hermit or reverie, so every slug names its repo. `validate.rs` is the ONE exception: hermit/scripts/validate.rs shipped that bare value BEFORE the column was load-bearing (nothing consumed it), and it stays registered so rows already written under it still verify. That writer now emits `hermit-validate-rs`; drop the legacy entry once no live ledger row carries it.
